text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Crown Prince Hassan emphasises to a group of visiting Israeli Arabs from the Islamic movement the need to work towards a comprehensive Middle East peace settlement.
- Prime Minister Kabariti tells his Syrian counterpart in a cable of condolences following Damascus bus bombing that "what befalls Syria affects us."
- Crown Prince departs on a visit to Britain and Spain.
- Iraqi-Jordanian higher committee talks begin in Baghdad this week; minister of trade and industry heads the delegation to Baghdad next Monday to discuss expanding business links.
- Supply Ministry imports 2,000 tonnes of frozen chicken of French origin to prevent price hikes during the coming Moslem fasting month of Ramadan.
- Seminar organised on Sunday over the election law is to be attended by 14 political parties, organisers say.
- Crown Prince expresses a wish to visit the Arab city of Acre in Israel while addressing Israeli Arabs.
- Opening of the first Israeli trade fair in Jordan is again delayed by organisers amid stepped-up campaign staged by opposition parties calling for its cancellation.
